description: Read the software keyboard state with status (alias get). A visible keyboard can include returnKey and its localized accessibility label. An unreadable Apple keyboard state reports OBSERVATION_UNAVAILABLE. Enter (alias return) sends Return to the focused input. The app may submit, move focus, or insert a newline. On the native iOS runner, dismiss succeeds as a no-op when the software keyboard is hidden. A visible keyboard returns keyboard_dismiss_unavailable with dispatched: no. Press the visible Hide Keyboard key or an app control that ends editing. If the app supports interactive dismissal, use gesture pan to drag a finger down from inside its scrollable content and verify with status. Android dismiss sends its platform dismissal action. Times out after 90s.
